items.message: @Polynomial.primPart : {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → [NormalizedGCDMonoid R] → Polynomial R → Polynomial R
@Polynomial.content : {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → [NormalizedGCDMonoid R] → Polynomial R → R
@Polynomial.IsPrimitive : {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → Polynomial R → Prop

@Polynomial.eq_C_content_mul_primPart : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : NormalizedGCDMonoid R]
  (p : Polynomial R), p = Polynomial.C p.content * p.primPart

@Polynomial.content_primPart : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : NormalizedGCDMonoid R] (p : Polynomial R),
  p.primPart.content = 1

@Polynomial.isUnit_or_eq_zero_of_isUnit_integerNormalization_primPart : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R]
  {K : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra R K] [inst_3 : IsFractionRing R K] [IsDomain R]
  [inst_5 : NormalizedGCDMonoid R] {p : Polynomial K},
  p ≠ 0 → IsUnit (IsLocalization.integerNormalization (nonZeroDivisors R) p).primPart → IsUnit p

@Roth.exists_int_eq_of_gcd_eq_one : ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {s : Finset ι} {u : ι → ℤ},
  s.gcd u = 1 → ∀ {v : ℚ}, (∀ a ∈ s, ∃ z, ↑(u a) * v = ↑z) → ∃ z, v = ↑z

theorem Roth.exists_int_eq_of_gcd_eq_one.{u_2} : ∀ {ι : Type u_2} {s : Finset ι} {u : ι → ℤ},
  s.gcd u = 1 → ∀ {v : ℚ}, (∀ a ∈ s, ∃ z, ↑(u a) * v = ↑z) → ∃ z, v = ↑z :=
fun {ι} {s} {u} hu {v} hv ↦
  Exists.casesOn (Roth.exists_sum_mul_eq_gcd s u) fun z hz ↦
    (fun w hw ↦
        Exists.intro (∑ i ∈ s, z i * w i)
          (Trans.trans
            (of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (Eq v)
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrFun'
                      (congrArg HMul.hMul
                        (Eq.trans (congrArg Int.cast (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, z i * u i = _a) hu) hz))
                          Int.cast_one))
                      v)
                    (one_mul v)))
                (eq_self v)))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congr
                  (congrArg Eq
                    (congrFun'
                      (congrArg HMul.hMul
                        (Eq.trans (Int.cast_sum s fun x ↦ z x * u x)
                          (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl s) fun x a ↦ Int.cast_mul (z x) (u x))))
                      v))
                  (Eq.trans (Int.cast_sum s fun x ↦ z x * w x)
                    (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl s) fun x a ↦ Int.cast_mul (z x) (w x)))))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a = ∑ x ∈ s, ↑(z x) * ↑(w x)) (Finset.sum_mul s (fun x ↦ ↑(z x) * ↑(u x)) v)))
                (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦
                  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a = ↑(z i) * ↑(w i)) (mul_assoc (↑(z i)) (↑(u i)) v)))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ↑(z i) * _a = ↑(z i) * ↑(w i)) (hw i hi)))
                      (Eq.refl (↑(z i) * ↑(w i)))))))))
      (fun a ↦ Function.sometimes fun a_1 ↦ Classical.choose (hv a a_1)) fun a a_1 ↦
      Function.sometimes_spec (fun z ↦ ↑(u a) * v = ↑z) (fun a_2 ↦ Classical.choose (hv a a_2)) a_1
        (Classical.choose_spec (hv a a_1))

INTEGRAL173_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {ι : Type u_2} {s : Finset ι} {u : ι → ℤ},
  s.gcd u = 1 → ∀ {v : ℚ}, (∀ a ∈ s, ∃ (z : ℤ), ↑(u a) * v = ↑z) → ∃ (z : ℤ), v = ↑z
